question: If Departmental proceedings are instituted against a pensioner, it shall not be in respect of any event which took place more than ________ years before such institution.
Retirement/death gratuity may be paid to the family after __________ in case an official's whereabouts are not known.

Explain how amount of pension is calculated in the following cases: (a) In case of Government servant retiring before completion of qualifying service of ten years (b) Government servant retiring after completing qualifying service of not less than 10 years.
In calculating the length of qualifying service, fraction of a year equal to ________ months and above shall be treated as a completed one half-year.
The amount of Family Pension shall be determined at a uniform rate of __________ of basic pay.
What is the difference between Retirement Gratuity and Death Gratuity?
The Head of Office shall undertake the work of preparation of pension papers in Form 7 __________ in advance before the due date of retirement of the government servant.

Answer any 3 (three) of the following questions: (a) Enumerate how periods spent on leave are counted for qualifying service. (b) What does the expression 'Appointing Authority' means in terms of CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972? (c) What are the conditions debarring a person from receiving gratuity? (d) What are the circumstances under which the Appointing Authority may allow counting of Extraordinary Leave taken other than on medical certificate as qualifying service for the purpose of pension?
The authority competent to accept the notice for voluntary retirement tendered under CCS(Pension) Rules,1972 is _________ .
Pay drawn by a government servant while on ___________ shall not be treated as emolument.
What actions can be taken on a Govt. servant who overstayed his/her leave without proper sanction?

A government servant compulsorily retired from service as a penalty may be granted by the competent authority pension or gratuity or both, at a rate not less than __________ to him on the date of his compulsory retirement.
What are the effects of dismissal or removal on the leave at credit of a Govt. servant?
Retirement on completion of 20 years' qualifying service is covered under __________ of CCS(Pension) Rules,1972.
How is the benefit of increment falling due during earned leave regulated?
Service on probation against a post if followed by__________ in the same or another post shall qualify.
Notice of at least __________ shall be given to a Government servant before his services are dispensed with on the abolition of his permanent post.
Can advance from GPF be granted before repayment of previous advance? If no, give reasons and If so, what is the condition?
A Government servant may, at any time, cancel a nomination by sending a notice in writing to the __________.
What is the procedure for conversion of an advance into withdrawal?
Dismissal or removal of a Government servant from a service or post entails forfeiture of his past service.
When does a nomination made or a notice of cancellation of nomination given by a subscriber take effect?
Recovery of pecuniary loss from pension shall not ordinarily be made at a rate exceeding two-third of the pension admissible on date of retirement of Government servant.
The right of a female member of the family of a Government servant to receive the share of gratuity lapses if she marries or re-marries after the death of a Government servant.
How will you regulate transfer grant in the following cases: (a) Transfer of husband and wife takes place within six months
Previous sanction of the Government is required for employment with a University after retirement.
Temporary employees are also eligible to seek voluntary retirement on completion of twenty years service.
Dearness Allowance does not count as emoluments for determining the amount of Gratuity.
Failure/refusal by pensioner to pay Government dues is considered as 'misconduct'.
Minor penalty proceedings have no effect on pension.
Leave should not ordinarily be denied during the last ______ years of service.
A Government servant who remains absent from duty for a continuous period of five years shall be deemed to__________ from Government service.
Leave ordinarily begins on the day on which transfer of charge is effected and ends on the day __________ that on which the charge is resumed.

A government servant who remains absent after the end of leave is entitled to no leave salary during such absence and that period shall be debited against the leave account as though it were __________.
The maximum earned leave that can be granted to any government servant at a time is __________ days.
Child care leave may not be granted for a period less than __________ days at a time.

Half pay leave up to a maximum of __________ days may be allowed to be commuted during the entire service without production of Medical Certificate where such leave is utilized for approved course of study certified to be in public interest.
Child Care Leave may be granted at __________ of the leave salary beyond 365 days.
Medical Certificate is not necessary for Leave not due in continuation of__________ leave.

Leave upto a period of __________ may be granted to an aggrieved female Government servant on the recommendation of the Internal Committee during the pendency of inquiry under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.
Advance credit of Earned Leave on 1st January and 1st July each year will be reduced by _________ of the period of Extraordinary Leave availed by Government Servant during the preceding half year.
The maximum period of child adoption leave that can be granted to a female Government servant is __________ days.

A subscriber shall, at the time of joining the __________, send to the Accounts Officer a nomination conferring on one or more persons the right to receive the amount that may stand to his credit in the event of his death.
A subscriber shall subscribe monthly to the Fund except during the period when he is under __________.
A government servant due to retire on superannuation shall be exempted from making any subscription to the GPF during the last __________ months of service.
Any sum withdrawn by a subscriber from the amount standing to his credit in the Fund shall not ordinarily exceed two-third of such amount or _________ months pay, whichever is less.
Withdrawals may be sanctioned within __________ months before the date of subscriber's retirement on superannuation from the amount standing to the credit in the Fund, without linking to any purpose.
When a subscriber quits the service, the amount standing to his credit in the Fund shall become __________ to him.
A nomination made by a subscriber __________ even if the subscriber dies before the nomination reaches the Accounts Officer.
In case of non-availability of seats in entitled class, Government servants may travel in the class __________ their entitled class.
A Government servant in transit from one post to another ranks in the grade to which the __________ of the two posts would entitled him.
At places where no specific rates have been prescribed, the rate per km will further rise by __________ percent whenever DA increases by 50 percent.
If there are two or more routes and the difference in journey time and fare is not great, mileage allowance may be allowed for the __________.

The Composite Transfer Grant shall be paid at the rate of __________ of the last month's basic pay in case of transfer involving a change of station located at a distance of or more than 20 kms from each other.
Traveling allowance __________ for the journey to join first posting in Government service.

Daily allowance may not be drawn for any day on which a Government servant does not reach a point __________ a radius of eight kilometers from the duty point at his headquarters or return to it from a similar point.
Transportation of personal effects by road is as per __________ basis only.
A journey on transfer is held to begin or end at the actual __________ of the Government servant concerned.
All Officers of the rank of __________ and above may be declared as their own Controlling Officers.
